name: trusta
description: Set up Trusta trust signals, fix security findings, and check your trust score — directly from Claude Code.
author: Trusta <hello@trusta.dev>

skills.name: trusta-setup
skills.description: Set up Trusta for this project: authenticate, create workspace/project/collector, write GitHub Actions workflow. Run trusta init then write the workflow file.

skills.name: trusta-fix
skills.description: Pull the latest Trusta security scan for this repo, fix the critical and high findings in code to maximise the trust score, then open a PR.

skills.name: trusta-status
skills.description: Show the current Trusta trust score, latest scan results, and check states for this project.
